SELECT asset_id AS assetId, COUNT(*) AS referenceCount FROM ( SELECT asset_id, source_type, source_id FROM ( SELECT image_file_id AS asset_id, 'marketing_template' AS source_type, id AS source_id FROM marketing_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND image_file_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT link_preview_asset_id, 'hyperlink_template', id FROM hyperlink_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND link_preview_asset_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT body_main_asset_id, 'hyperlink_template', id FROM hyperlink_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND body_main_asset_id IN #{id} ) raw_references GROUP BY asset_id, source_type, source_id ) distinct_references GROUP BY asset_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT source_type, source_id FROM ( SELECT 'marketing_template' AS source_type, id AS source_id FROM marketing_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND image_file_id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT 'hyperlink_template', id FROM hyperlink_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND link_preview_asset_id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT 'hyperlink_template', id FROM hyperlink_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND body_main_asset_id = #{id} ) raw_references GROUP BY source_type, source_id ) distinct_references
